author: 3owj
content: Implemented: new csnotes check command (src/commands/check_cmd.rs) backed by audit::check_workspace(). Runs block-ID uniqueness, block-anchor presence, and link resolution against _synthetic/ without needing a session report. Exits 1 on hard violations with actionable output. Updated both AI instruction files and their init.rs source constants to run csnotes check as the first step in Before you exit.
